comment: Boundary probes for substantive shell artifacts. POSIX sh, Bash, and PowerShell have dedicated references; other shells use the explicit bounded fallback. Incidental commands are excluded.

queries.query: Fix argument handling in scripts/install.sh, which runs under dash and BusyBox sh.
Repair this PowerShell module so native command failures propagate without converting pipeline objects to strings.
Write a Bash script for this repository that compresses log files older than a week and deletes archives older than ninety days.
Use $shell-development to review this Bash deployment script's traps, arrays, and exit statuses.
Harden the Bash run block in this GitHub Actions job that passes a secret and user-selected deployment target to a CLI.
Update my maintained zsh plugin to use zsh associative arrays and completion widgets.
Fix this fish function and its abbreviations in config.fish.
Run a single ls command so you can see which files are present; do not create a script.
